pages.title: Home Bell
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted from a Copper Ingot above a Stick (two vertical slots).$(br2)§lEffect: §r Ringing it calls back every girl that belongs to its owner in the same dimension — even those resting in unloaded chunks will follow the sound home.$(br2)2-second cooldown.
Recipe: a Copper Ingot on top, a Stick below.
